decisions.reason: The source changes the main-board dimensions and layout while reiterating enclosure rails; it does not change the sensor board's existing mechanical constraints.
The 70×50 mm outline, connector arrangement, and ESP32 edge placement apply to the main board, not the power board.
The source does not discuss or alter the power-board battery connector's location, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
Accepting ESP32 placement on the PCB edge is a main-board mechanical-layout decision and does not change the module model or breakout-hole requirements.
The source contains no decision about the standalone regulator, current capacity, power source selection, or powered load.
Connector retention and main-board rearrangement do not alter I2C speed, cable length, pull-ups, or series-resistor conditioning.
The existing separate interboard connector definitions and pinouts remain valid; the source rejects physical consolidation but does not change those interfaces.
The candidate already specifies individual per-sensor connectors and cables; rejecting a consolidated connector leaves that interface inventory unchanged.
The main-board mechanical-layout decision does not change the DCDC1 output voltage or Schottky-drop compensation requirement.
The source does not change the monitoring IC, measured rails, monitor placement, or measurement coverage.
Retaining individual connectors does not alter the specified BOOT button, reset connection, or pin capacitances.
ESP32 physical edge placement and board resizing do not alter any GPIO assignment or compatibility constraint.
